title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
description: Build and deploy machine learning models in Python using TensorFlow and scikit-learn. Work on data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training and evaluation. Experience with CNNs and transfer learning is a plus.

title: Backend Developer Intern (Java)
description: Develop REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot. Design MySQL and PostgreSQL schemas, write unit tests, and integrate third-party APIs. Git and code reviews are part of daily work.

title: NLP Engineer Intern
description: Work on text classification, named entity recognition and sentence embeddings using Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face transformers. Build semantic search over documents with vector databases.

title: AI Agent Developer Intern
description: Build LLM-powered AI agents that call tools, plan multi-step tasks and retrieve context using retrieval augmented generation (RAG). Python, prompt engineering, embeddings and FAISS or vector databases required.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Analyse business data with SQL, Pandas and Excel. Build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau and present insights to stakeholders. Strong statistics and data visualization skills with Matplotlib or Seaborn.

title: Android Developer Intern
description: Build native Android apps in Kotlin and Java. Integrate REST APIs, manage local storage with SQLite and Room, and publish to the Play Store. Knowledge of Jetpack Compose is a plus.

title: Search Relevance Engineer Intern
description: Improve ranking and relevance for a search engine. Work on semantic search, dense retrieval with embeddings, BM25, query understanding and offline evaluation metrics such as NDCG and recall.

title: Computer Vision Intern
description: Train image classification and object detection models with TensorFlow, Keras or PyTorch. Data augmentation, transfer learning with pre-trained backbones like EfficientNet and ResNet, and model evaluation.

title: DevOps Intern
description: Automate CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Jenkins. Containerize services with Docker, deploy on Kubernetes and AWS, and monitor systems with Prometheus and Grafana. Linux and shell scripting required.

title: Recommendation Systems Intern
description: Build recommendation and matching systems that rank candidates or items for users. Collaborative filtering, embeddings, approximate nearest neighbour search and A/B testing. Python and SQL.

title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Build responsive web interfaces with React, TypeScript, HTML and CSS. Work with designers in Figma, consume REST APIs and write component tests.

title: Network Engineer Trainee
description: Configure routers and switches, troubleshoot TCP/IP networks, and work with wireless networks and network security. Knowledge of computer networks, routing protocols and network simulation tools.

title: IoT and Wireless Sensor Network Intern
description: Design and simulate wireless sensor networks for industrial IoT. Optimize node and relay placement for reliability, analyse link quality, and use Python with NetworkX for network modelling. Embedded systems and Arduino experience helpful.

title: Optimization and Operations Research Intern
description: Formulate and solve optimization problems using heuristics and metaheuristics such as genetic algorithms, simulated annealing and particle swarm optimization. Multi-objective fitness functions, Python, NumPy and SciPy.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst Intern
description: Monitor security events, perform vulnerability assessment, and study cryptography, SSL/TLS and network security protocols. Familiarity with Linux, Wireshark and security frameworks.

title: Software Engineer Intern - Job Matching
description: Build job matching systems that parse resumes and job descriptions, compute semantic similarity with sentence embeddings, and rank candidates. Python backend, REST APIs, vector search and LLM-based explanations.

title: Data Engineer Intern
description: Build ETL pipelines with Python, SQL and Apache Spark. Manage data warehouses, schedule jobs with Airflow and ensure data quality across PostgreSQL and cloud storage.

title: Embedded Systems Intern
description: Program microcontrollers in C and C++, work with Arduino and ARM boards, sensors, motor drivers and serial communication. Debug hardware with oscilloscopes and write firmware.

title: Full Stack Developer Intern
description: Develop web applications with Node.js, Express, React and MongoDB. Build REST APIs, handle authentication and deploy apps to the cloud.

title: Generative AI Intern
description: Prototype applications with large language models, prompt engineering, fine-tuning and RAG pipelines. Use LangChain, OpenAI or open-source models, embeddings and vector stores like FAISS.

title: Python Developer Intern
description: Write clean Python code for backend services using Flask or FastAPI. Work with SQL databases, write unit tests and use Git for version control.

title: Quality Assurance Intern
description: Write test cases, perform manual and automated testing with Selenium, prepare test data, and document test results. Basic SQL and Java knowledge.

title: Research Intern - Applied ML for Systems
description: Apply machine learning to systems problems such as predicting network link failures and optimizing resource placement. Python, scikit-learn, deep learning and simulation experience preferred.

title: Competitive Programming Trainer
description: Teach data structures and algorithms, graph algorithms, dynamic programming and greedy techniques. Create practice problems and editorials in C++ or Java.
